title: One-off handshake delta catalog
content:
Purpose:
A small, one-off tracker to capture recent 'handshake' / owner deltas across cross-functional endpoints. Lightweight compared to the weekly roster: meant for fast triage and an operations handback the weekend of 2029-08-24.

How to use:
- Update the "owner" column when you reach out or accept an owner.
- Delta = current_open_items - last_snapshot_open_items (last snapshot 2029-08-10). Positive delta = more work.
- Weekend risk: subjective quick call (H/M/L) for coverage needs.

Quick totals (pivot):
- Services tracked: 9
- Total open items (current): 47
- Total delta vs 2029-08-10: +12
- High weekend risk items: 6

Table (columns: service | last_owner | current_owner | last_snapshot | current_open | delta | open_tickets | weekend_risk | next_action | blocker)
-----------------------------------------------------------
ingress-router          | Priya S.      | Priya S.     | 3  | 2  | -1  | ENG-4123        | Low  | monitor | none
edge-rate-limiter       | N/A           | Daniel K.    | 0  | 5  | +5  | JIRA-8391       | High | triage + owner onboarding | capacity slot shortage
eval-caching            | Ethan W.      | Ethan W.     | 4  | 4  | 0   | none            | Med  | run overnight sample | flaky infra tests
dedicated-provisioning  | Chloe M.      | Chloe M.     | 6  | 7  | +1  | PR-224          | Med  | confirm quota increase | pending finance signoff
stable-model-fallback   | Maya R.       | Maya R.     | 1  | 3  | +2  | SVC-271         | High | add canary rule | old policy blocks fallback
private-deployments     | Liam O'C.     | Liam O'C.    | 8  | 9  | +1  | TKT-1102        | Low  | schedule handoff | none
billing-triage          | Aisha P.      | Aisha P.     | 2  | 4  | +2  | FIN-56          | Med  | escalate to billing lead | invoice lagging data
observability-routes    | Rowan L.      | Rowan L.     | 3  | 1  | -2  | none            | Low  | re-check alerts | reduced noise config done
se-routing-interop      | N/A           | Squad: SE-P    | 0  | 12 | +12 | SEP-122, SEP-125| High | coordinate SE handoff + docs | missing runbook

Notes and quick checks (freeform):
- edge-rate-limiter jump looks real (new client spike + no burst pool). Daniel K. is patching but we should open a temporary burst slot if possible; flagged to platform-engineering.
- se-routing-interop entries are a consolidation of many small SE tickets; call with solutions-eng Monday to split into 2 owners.
- billing-triage: two invoices that failed processing; likely cause: tokenization mismatch in billing batch. Flagging FIN-56 and copying payments-ops.

Open questions / To-solve before weekend:
- Can platform provide a 24-hour burst pool for edge-rate-limiter? (owner: Priya to escalate to infra lead)
- Who can take the SE bulk list? (owner: Maya to coordinate with SE lead to split ownership)
- Confirm weekend on-call escalation path for private-deployments (owner: Liam)

Action checklist (short):
- [ ] Daniel to open formal burst request ticket (by 2029-08-15)
- [ ] Maya to run SE split session (by 2029-08-19)
- [ ] Aisha to escalate billing batch to payments-ops and attach sample payloads (by 2029-08-16)
- [ ] Chloe to confirm quota increase timeline with Finance (by 2029-08-20)

Quick method note (for future runs):
- Use CSV export from lightweight-coverage script (scripts/ops/coverage-snap.py) then paste into this sheet; compute delta by comparing snapshot date columns.

Notes-to-self:
- This is intentionally crude; aim to resolve top 4 high-risk items before weekend and then hand back a one-paragraph summary to ops-coverage Slack.
- Add final 'handed-back' timestamp when done.

Related artifacts:
- Confluence: handback guidelines page (linked above).
- JIRA-8391: edge-rate-limiter surge tracker (primary ticket).
- Slack thread: #ops-handback (ongoing conversation).

End of doc.
